source.supports: author-reported hashcat v6.2.6 RTX 4090 mode18200 benchmark, 3564.1 MH/s; scale sanity check only, not achieved distinct guesses or password coverage

benchmark.transfer_to_scenario: refused: benchmark kernel, hardware, hash count, candidate length, verifier mode/etype, driver, attack strategy and overhead differ; H/s is not distinct candidate coverage

full_history_scope: native ordered canonical work identities plus actor/source/target/auth, method, resource, scenario, snapshot, budget, policy and horizon; unrelated histories refused

natural_password.required: joint conditional rank mass and completed compatible verifier coverage before deadline; include secret validity and no-match stop semantics

transfers.rationale: New AI-assisted operational judgment for compatible AS-REP material acquisition, not transferred from reset-derived credential activation. Under stable reachable KDC and supported request/parser, propose 1%-10% residual whole-event failure allowance for request/response timeout, resource contention and material parsing within three requests/10 minutes. These allowances require B numeric adoption; specifications support event semantics only.

q=P(password rank is covered AND verifier completes and validates by deadline | acquisition, F/S, full history). A cap alone gives no completed-compute floor and unknown natural-password rank supplies no success mass. q is absent. uniform24 arithmetic remains an archived counterfactual fixture, never a natural-password estimate.

Proposed transfer of the reviewed reset-derived Kerberos activation interval only after E1/E2 succeeded and the scenario declares unchanged valid password/account policy. Recovery lineage differs from reset lineage; the full new history is a separate explicit case. Password validity gates do not erase residual exchange/policy uncertainty.

Proposed transfer of the historical WinRM terminal interval to the same DC typed consequence, with an explicit WinRM scenario policy. The generated semantic method remains AdminTo. Generic unspecified admin_channel, RDP/session, DA membership or a different resource cannot borrow it. Full recovery/activation history and 24h horizon must be accepted separately.

uniform24.conclusion: low q describes deliberately small coverage of uniform24, not AS-REP difficulty
